shell_text.default: [Player A], you are [personas] until further notice. Speak in your normal voice and take [Penalty, 2] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you are no longer [personas].

shell_text.default: [Player A], pick up a [accents] accent right now and keep it until further notice. Slip back to normal and take [Penalty, 2] per slip.

closer.default: [Player A], you can drop the accent.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you only communicate in the sounds [animals] makes until further notice. Use actual words and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can use real words again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [speech_constraints]. Slip and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can speak freely again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], start every sentence with '[mandatory_openers]' until further notice. Skip it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can drop the '[mandatory_openers]' opener.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [body_effects]. Slip and take [Penalty, 2] per offense.

closer.default: [Player A], you can move normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [social_restrictions]. Slip and take [Penalty, 2] per offense.

closer.default: [Player A], that restriction's off.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [social_openers]. Skip it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can skip the opener now.

shell_text.default: The group gets to give [Player A] a title right now. [Player A], you must answer to it until further notice. Use your real name instead and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], your real name works again.

shell_text.default: Nobody says '[banned_words]' until further notice. Say it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: '[banned_words]' is fair game again.

shell_text.default: [Player A]'s name is off-limits until further notice. Say it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A]'s name is fair game again.

shell_text.default: New rule, until further notice. [group_rules]. Any slip costs [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Everyone talks normally again.

shell_text.default: Nobody brings up [topic] until further notice. Mention it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [topic] is back on the table.

shell_text.default: [Player A], work '[trigger_words]' into conversation at least once per prompt until further notice. Finish a prompt without saying it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can drop the '[trigger_words]' quota.

shell_text.default: Before anyone takes a penalty until further notice, everyone must [activefx_rituals] first. Skip the ritual and the penalty doubles.

closer.default: Penalties go straight through again.

shell_text.default: Everyone must snap before they start speaking until further notice. Skip it and take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: No more snapping before you speak.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every time someone says your name until further notice, respond immediately with '[activefx_catchphrases]'. Fail to respond and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can stop shouting '[activefx_catchphrases]' at your name.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every time you make a claim about yourself until further notice, do air quotes around the key word. Miss it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can drop the air quotes.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you take until further notice, you must [penalty_ceremonies] first. Skip it and the penalty doubles.

closer.default: [Player A], no more ceremony before your penalties.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [suppression_targets]. Everyone else, make it hard. Break and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can let go now.

shell_text.default: New rule, until further notice. [group_rules]. Anyone who breaks it makes the whole group take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: That rule's lifted, everyone.

shell_text.default: Everyone keeps one hand on their head until further notice. Whoever's hand drops makes the whole group take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: Hands off your heads, everyone.

shell_text.default: Everyone gets the same target word, '[trigger_words]'. First to work it into conversation naturally wins, and everyone else takes [Penalty, 2]. Get called out mid-attempt and you take [Penalty, 2]. Nobody lands it in 5 minutes? Everyone takes [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: Time's up on the word race.

shell_text.default: [Player A], secretly pick a verbal tic and work it into everything you say. First person to correctly call it out picks someone to take [Penalty, 2]. If nobody's named it when this effect ends, you take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Time's up, [Player A]. Reveal the tic, and if nobody caught it, take [Penalty, 2].

shell_text.default: [Player A], at some point before this effect ends, you'll tell one lie in conversation. Nobody knows when. Caught? You take [Penalty, 2]. Wrong accusation? The accuser takes [Penalty, 2]. Nobody catches it before the effect ends? You hand out [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Time's up, [Player A]. Own the lie, and if it slid past everyone, hand out [Penalty, 2].

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you take until further notice is doubled. The rest of the group stays normal.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties are back to normal size.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you take until further notice is halved, rounded up.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties count in full again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you give out until further notice is doubled.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties go back to normal size.

shell_text.default: [Player A], any penalty targeting you until further notice automatically passes to the person on your left. They take it instead.

closer.default: [Player A], your penalties are yours again.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you're linked until further notice. Any penalty either of you takes, you both take.

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], your penalties are your own again.

shell_text.default: The next penalty any player takes spreads to the whole group. Everyone takes [Penalty, 1] the first time someone gets hit. After that, normal rules resume.

closer.default: Penalties stay with whoever earns them now.

shell_text.default: Until further notice, every penalty anyone takes gets added to a pot. When the effect ends, one person is chosen at random and takes the whole pot at once.

closer.default: The pot's closed. Pick a name at random, that person takes the whole thing.

shell_text.default: [Player A], any penalty you give out until further notice must be at least [Penalty, 3], no matter what the prompt says.

closer.default: [Player A], give out whatever the prompt says again.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're cursed until further notice. Every penalty you take is doubled. The moment you [transfer_triggers], the curse transfers to them. Make it happen fast.

closer.default: The curse burns out. Whoever's holding it is back to normal penalties.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're holding the hot potato. To pass it, [transfer_triggers]. Whoever falls for it takes [Penalty, 1] and becomes the new holder. Holding it when the effect ends costs [Penalty, 4].

closer.default: Time's up. Whoever's holding the potato takes [Penalty, 4].

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [escalating_constraints]. First slip costs [Penalty, 1]. Second costs [Penalty, 2]. Third costs [Penalty, 3].

closer.default: [Player A], the constraint's off.

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty you take until further notice is banked. You don't pay it now. When the effect ends, you take it all at once.

closer.default: [Player A], tally up your bank and take it all now.

shell_text.default: All penalties are doubled until further notice.

closer.default: Penalties are back to normal for everyone.

shell_text.default: Every penalty until further notice is at least [Penalty, 3], no matter what.

closer.default: Penalties go back to whatever the prompt says.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you're both speaking in a [accents] accent until further notice. Either of you slips and you both take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you can drop the accent.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you speak only [activefx_opposite_styles.a]. [Player B], you speak only [activefx_opposite_styles.b]. Either of you slips and you both take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], you can talk normally again.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], if either of you laughs until further notice, you both take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A] and [Player B], laugh all you want now.

shell_text.default: [Player A], [Player B] will echo the last word of every sentence you say until further notice. If [Player B] misses an echo, you both take [Penalty, 1].

closer.default: [Player B], you're done echoing [Player A].

shell_text.default: Everyone takes on a [personas] persona until further notice. Drop it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Everyone, you're no longer [personas].

shell_text.default: Everyone picks up a [accents] accent until further notice. Drop it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Everyone, drop the accent.

shell_text.default: [Player A], mirror everything [Player B] does physically until further notice. If the group thinks you've fallen out of sync, you take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can stop mirroring [Player B].

shell_text.default: [Player A], every penalty [Player B] takes until further notice, you take too. You're anchored to them.

closer.default: [Player A], you're cut loose from [Player B].

shell_text.default: [Player A], you're immune until further notice. When the effect ends, you take [Penalty, max] for the immunity.

closer.default: [Player A], immunity's up. Take [Penalty, max] for the free ride.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [speech_constraints]. Make it to the end without a single slip and you hand out [Penalty, 2] to anyone you choose. Slip even once? You take [Penalty, 3] right then, and the effect ends.

closer.default: [Player A], you made it clean. Hand out [Penalty, 2] to whoever you want.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [specific_immunities]. Everything else still counts.

closer.default: [Player A], everything counts again.

shell_text.default: New rule, until further notice. [group_rules]. First breach costs [Penalty, 1]. Second costs [Penalty, 2]. Third costs [Penalty, 3].

closer.default: That rule's off, everyone.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [spicy_directed_rules]. Drop the act and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can drop the act now.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [degen_narration_rules]. Drop the voice and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you're done narrating.

shell_text.default: [Player A], until further notice, [degen_drink_rules]. Break it and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], drink however you want again.

shell_text.default: Buffalo rules until further notice. Drinks stay in your non-dominant hand. Get caught holding yours in your dominant hand and take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: Buffalo's off, drink with either hand.

shell_text.default: [Player A], you must have the last word in every exchange until further notice. If someone speaks after you without you getting another word in, take [Penalty, 2].

closer.default: [Player A], you can let someone else have the last word now.
